conbody.p: Impact, under Verify in the project menu, answers "what does a change to this artifact touch?" before you make it. Pick the artifact, or open the page from Show impact → on an artifact or a row of the Traceability Matrix.

ul.li: Direction — Downstream lists what depends on the artifact (what a change here could affect), Upstream what it depends on (its sources and rationale), and Both shows the two side by side.

Results are grouped by type — user needs, requirements, design items, test cases, hazards — with how each one is reached: the link it came through and how many hops away it is, so a direct dependent reads apart from one three links down the chain.

conbody.p: Run it before changing an approved requirement: the downstream list is the set of artifacts whose links will turn suspect and that may need review again.
